$comment: A worked example of the x-repo-profile extension points in ../schemas. A consumer writes its own file like this one and changes nothing in schemas/ — that is the whole portability contract. Deliberately not any real consumer's profile: shipping one repo's vocabulary from a portable package is the coupling this package exists to remove.

publish-modes.description: The portable schema fixes the shape; a consumer narrows the set it actually uses. It may only ever narrow — a profile cannot introduce a mode the portable enum does not carry, and cannot re-enable a retired one.

tier-policy.description: Deliberately a different tier set from any real consumer's, so a test using this profile fails if the validator has a consumer's vocabulary baked in rather than reading it from here.

generated-artifacts.description: Whatever generated proof surfaces the consumer's specs point at.
